title: Aston Martin The Americas: Obstructed Rearview Camera Image/FMVSS 111 (1,452 affected)
summary: Aston Martin The Americas (Aston Martin) is recalling certain 2024-2025 DB12, 2025 Vantage, and 2025 DBX707 vehicles.  The rearview camera image may be obstructed by the infotainment home screen menu when the vehicle is placed in reverse.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Tesla, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Fail/FMVSS 111 (239,382 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Model 3, Model S, 2023-2025 Model X, and Model Y vehicles.  The computer circuit board may short, resulting in the loss of the rearview camera image.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Blue Bird Body Company: Reversed High/Low Beam Headlight Wiring/FMVSS 108 (91 affected)
summary: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2024-2025 All American school buses.  Due to incorrect wiring, the high and low beams are reversed, causing the high beam indicator to illuminate incorrectly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Blue Bird Body Company: Reversed High/Low Beam Headlight Wiring/FMVSS 108 (1 affected)
summary: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling one 2025 All American transit bus.  Due to incorrect wiring, the high and low beams are reversed, causing the high beam indicator to illuminate incorrectly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Kia America, Inc.: Loss of Headlights and Taillights/FMVSS 108 (74,469 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Sorento, 2025 Sorento Hybrid, and 2025 Sorento Plug-In Hybrid vehicles.  A software error in the Body Domain Control Unit (BDC) may cause a loss of low beam headlights and taillights.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: N&B Mobility Solutions LLC: Charger Adapter May Cause Arcing or Shock Risk (130 affected)
summary: N&B Mobility Solutions LLC (Nivion) is recalling certain Nivion NSP01 charger adapters.  Insufficient clearance between direct-current (DC) busbars inside the charger adapter can lead to electrical arcing.  Also, the adapter is missing an electrical status switch to prevent disconnection while charging.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Cooktop Burner Tube May Crack and Cause Gas Leak (396 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025 Shasta Oasis and Spirit travel trailers equipped with InVision Three Burner Cooktops.  The aluminum burner tube may crack and cause a gas leak.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Spare Tire Carrier May Detach (107 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2025 Minnie Winnie and Spirit motorhomes.  The spare tire carrier mounting bolts may loosen, allowing the carrier to detach.

title: Palfinger, Inc.: Incorrectly Positioned Rear Marker Lights/FMVSS108 (2,149 affected)
summary: Palfinger, Inc. (Palfinger) is recalling certain 2017-2025 FHS 55 and GLS 55 vehicles.  The outer rear marker lights were installed in the incorrect location.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: GKN Automotive: Driveshaft Can Break (18 affected)
summary: GKN Automotive (GKN) is recalling certain replacement driveshafts for 2006-2015 BMW Mini, 2004-2018 Land Rover Discovery, and Range Rover vehicles.  The driveshaft can crack or break.

title: Marion Body Works Inc.: Cab Tilt Cylinder May Overextend and Drop the Cab (2 affected)
summary: Marion Body Works Inc. (Marion Body Works) is recalling certain 2024 Spartan Fire Metro Star vehicles.  A missing mechanical stop may allow the cab tilt cylinder to be overextended.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Loss of Drive Power from Damaged Cables (118 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024 Acura ZDX vehicles.  The front passenger stabilizer bar bracket bolts may become loose and detach from the frame, which can damage the high voltage cables or EV battery coolant lines.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display (5,329 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Jaguar XE vehicles.  Due to wiring damage in the trunk, the rearview camera image may not appear on the display.
